title: The Angels Are Told of a Khalifah
art: No one stands at the centre of the court. Divine speech is shown only as light and as words written in the air.
imagePrompt: A vast heavenly court of light: endless ranks of angels as tall columns of white-gold light receding into golden haze, an empty centre filled only by overwhelming radiance and slow rays; Arabic calligraphy glowing in the air, written stroke by stroke; a ripple of light passing through the ranks of angels.

beats.say: The angels stood in endless ranks, and a word came to them.
Allah told them He would place a khalifah, a successor, upon the earth.

verse.en: Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority.

beats.say: They asked how one who might spread corruption and shed blood could be chosen, while they praised Him.

verse.en: Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?
Indeed, I know that which you do not know.
